manifest_metadata.title: SatyaDrishti Clean Benchmark Sample-Level Evaluation Manifest

exclusion_rules.rule_1_train_leakage: Exclude any sample whose source file, subject ID (Celeb-DF 0-38), or sequence pair (FF++ train.json) belongs to the training split.
exclusion_rules.rule_2_val_leakage: Exclude any sample whose source file, subject ID (Celeb-DF 39-48), or sequence pair (FF++ val.json) belongs to the validation split.
exclusion_rules.rule_3_frame_independence: Do not treat frames from the same video as independent test items; evaluate image and video sets separately.

quality_gate.rejection_reason: No detectable human face was found in this image. SatyaDrishti's current image deepfake detector is designed for facial-media authenticity analysis. Upload a clear image containing a visible human face.
